email.subject: Reefer RF-4091 temperature deviation alert
email.body:
Marcus, unit RF-4091 in Warehouse Bay 3 is showing +4.2°C — 0.7°C above setpoint. Power cycle was attempted at 08:15; temperature is stabilizing slowly but not yet nominal. Requesting urgent technician dispatch within 2 hours to avoid cold chain cargo risk.

Carlos Mendez
Warehouse Bay & Logistics Manager, Antwerp

email.subject: Rotterdam customs hold on shipment MM-8492
email.body:
David / Sarah: Pharma consignment MM-8492 has been flagged for customs detention at Maasvlakte due to a missing Certificate of Analysis batch reference. Customs demands corrected documents by EOD today. Please obtain the revised COA from the shipper and submit through the ATLAS portal immediately.

Helena Chen
Customs Compliance Officer

email.subject: Bill of lading correction required: BL-MM-9931
email.body:
Consignee noted an HS code discrepancy on Bill of Lading BL-MM-9931: currently listed as 3004.90, but should be 3004.90.10 for antiviral compound formulations. Please revise and reissue the BL before vessel departure from Rotterdam at 1400Z.

Sarah Al-Mansoor
Key Accounts Director

email.subject: Bremerhaven demurrage dispute — $1,450 charge
email.body:
Terminal invoiced $1,450 demurrage for container TCNU7890123 alleging late pickup. Gate telemetry confirms customs release at 08:15 local and gate-out at 08:47. Attaching terminal interchange receipts. Requesting formal dispute filing before 17:00 CET today.

David Ross
Rotterdam Dispatch

email.subject: Algeciras bunkering slot confirmed for MV Meridian Voyager
email.body:
Captain Lindholm, bunker slot secured at Algeciras West Dock, berth 12, ETA 06:00Z tomorrow. 380 MT VLSFO at $682/MT. Confirm ETA and prepare manifolds. Pilot boards at 05:45Z. No departure adjustments permitted without operations clearance.

Liam O'Connor
Fuel & Bunkering Manager

email.subject: Felixstowe Chassis Shortage Alert - Immediate Action Required
email.body:
Urgent: Felixstowe terminal reports critical chassis shortage affecting outbound bookings after 14:00 today. Prioritize Antwerp and Rotterdam loads for rail swap. Confirm alternate routing by 10:00. Do not dispatch without chassis pre-allocation.

David Ross
Port Dispatch Coordinator

email.subject: Re: Felixstowe Chassis Shortage Alert - Immediate Action Required
email.body:
David, Tilbury rail hub has 15 bare chassis available. Shifting 8 high-cube containers to rail car flatbeds departing 11:30. This avoids the bottleneck.

Carlos
